title: Cookie Polisi
html:
Dis Cookie Polisi dey explain how Kyber (“we”, “us” and “awa”) dey use cookies and oda technology wey be like dem to recognise you wen you visit awa website for https://kyber.stream (“Website”). E dey explain wetin dis technology dem be and why we dey use dem, plus di rights wey you get to control how we dey use dem.

Wetin be cookies?

Cookies na small data files wey dem dey put for your computer or mobile device wen you visit website. Pipo wey get website dey use cookies well-well so dat dia website go fit work, or make e work better, and also to give information for reporting.

Why we dey use cookies?

We dey use first party and third party cookies for different reasons. Some cookies dey required for technical reasons so dat awa Website go fit work, and we dey call dem “essential” or “strictly necessary” cookies. Oda cookies dey make am possible for us to track and target wetin awa users like, so dat we fit make di experience for awa Website better. Third parties dey put cookies through awa Website for advertising, analytics and oda purposes.

How I fit control cookies?

You get di right to decide weda you go accept or reject cookies. You fit set your cookie preferences by clicking di correct opt-out links wey dey inside di cookie banner wey you go see di first time wey you visit awa Website.

You fit set or change di controls for your web browser make e accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject cookies, you fit still use awa Website, but dem fit restrict your access to some functions and some areas for awa Website.

How often una go dey update dis Cookie Polisi?

We fit update dis Cookie Polisi from time to time to show, for example, changes to di cookies wey we dey use or for oda operational, legal or regulatory reasons. So abeg, dey come back check dis Cookie Polisi regularly so dat you go dey informed about how we dey use cookies and oda technology wey relate to am.

Di date wey dey for di top of dis Cookie Polisi dey show wen we update am last.

Where I fit get more information?

If you get any question about how we dey use cookies or oda technology, abeg email us for dpo@kyber.media.
